name: pre-PR default presentation comparison
checks: 168 equivalent presentation scenes rendered by both actual versions
all image dimensions equal; 167 complete RGBA pixel matches
remaining scene differs at five pixels on the typography SVG; no layout, path or computed-color difference
isolated software-rasterized recapture of that scene is pixel-identical
details: The complete final run retains five differing pixels on one Aa glyph even with software rasterization; an isolated software recapture matched exactly. Source SVG path, screen matrix, geometry and computed fill/color agree. Screenshots, comparison runner and raw reports are retained as one-time local qualification artifacts outside the repository. This is not a permanent second runtime or a source-shape test.

conditions.reference: isolated historical archive and its local demo, outside the maintained repository
